title: Notion AI Pricing 2026: Plans, Costs, Is It Worth It?
summary: Notion AI pricing offers three tiers with escalating features and costs. Compare them to determine whether the investment suits your workflow.
body_markdown:
## Automating around Notion with Activepieces


If your team's work lives in Notion but your tasks cross into other apps, Activepieces covers the gap Notion AI leaves.


It doesn't answer the pricing question, but it connects Notion to the rest of your apps through 746 integrations, a count taken from its open source monorepo.


### What Notion's built-in automation covers


Inside Notion, the built-in automation does its job well. A database can update a status, assign a person or create a page when something changes, and a button can run a set of those steps on demand.


Notion AI then summarizes, drafts and answers questions over the pages your team already keeps there.


The limit is the edge of the workspace. The moment a job starts in your invoicing tool, a form, a chat channel or a customer inbox, Notion's own automation has less to work with.


Paying for more AI seats doesn't fix that, because the problem is moving data between apps, not writing better text.


### What a workflow tool adds


Think of Activepieces as a workflow builder with an MIT-licensed core.


You pick an event in one app, such as a new form response, and chain it to actions in others, such as adding a row to a Notion database and posting a message to your team. Roughly 60% of its integrations are community-contributed.


Each of these chains is called a flow, and each app connection is called a piece.


That makes it the plumbing around Notion. It carries the data in and out, and Notion AI keeps doing the reading and writing once the data lands.


The two don't compete. One builder can use both, and a solo builder who only needs the plumbing can skip the AI seat entirely.


The[Activepieces pricing page](https://www.activepieces.com/pricing) lists 1 credit per flow run however many steps it has, so the form-to-Notion-row-to-chat-message chain above costs one credit, where Zapier's pricing page bills the same chain per task and Make's per module.


The free plan carries 1,000 credits a month, unlimited flows and up to 5 users. That covers a light automation, though it leaves open the question of who needs a Notion AI seat.
